fieldValues.title: Should navigation depth come from the contains tree or from container outlines?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (2. Reading order and sections: a few areas, then deeper), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Container outlines only: depth is arrangement and the outline is the navigation.
- B. The contains tree only, as decision 0750c62f says.
- C. Both, kept apart: outlines for reading, contains for meaning.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Where the two disagree today and which one readers and agents actually follow.
fieldValues.next_action: Diff the contains tree and the outlines in srs/srs and srs-programme and read the disagreements.
